The application comes in a simple and free-of-charge entry version. This version is designed to obtain fast results without having to log in. It provides a first visual impression through innovative technology, which features simple adjustment possibilities and image file sharing (PNG). 
The more advanced and therefore paid option is designed to visualize the treatment results in a sophisticated, effective and at the same time efficient way. To access this version basic registration of details is required in order to unlock the MP4 file sharing facility and further advanced adjustment possibilities.
